tools.name: cortex.get_project_brief
tools.description: Return the generated project brief (.cortex/project.md). Reports exists:false when the workspace has not generated one yet.

tools.name: cortex.get_architecture_map
tools.description: Return the generated architecture map (.cortex/architecture.md). Reports exists:false when absent.

tools.name: cortex.get_quality_constitution
tools.description: Return the project quality constitution (.cortex/quality-constitution.md). Reports exists:false when absent.

tools.name: cortex.get_feature_ledger
tools.description: Read the feature ledger: a single feature by id, all features filtered by status, or every feature.

id.description: Return only the feature with this id.

tools.name: cortex.update_memory
tools.description: Append a new memory item, or patch an existing one when `id` is provided. Memory carries confidence + evidence so unverified facts are never promoted to permanent truth.

id.description: When set, patch this existing memory item.

tools.name: cortex.record_evidence
tools.description: Append an immutable EvidenceItem (verified/partial/refuted/unverified) to the append-only evidence ledger.

tools.name: cortex.classify_task_risk
tools.description: Classify a task into a RiskClassification (riskLevel, taskType, signals, rationale) using keyword + affected-file analysis honoring config risk floors.

tools.name: cortex.compile_intent
tools.description: Turn a vague task into a precise engineering contract (goals, acceptance criteria, stages, verification plan, definition of done).

tools.name: cortex.compile_context
tools.description: Assemble the minimum-complete, compressed context pack for a task. Depth defaults to the risk-derived depth (tiny/standard/deep) unless overridden.

tools.name: cortex.analyze_blast_radius
tools.description: Given changed files, compute what could break (routes, components, api, tables, auth/billing, env, tests, fragile areas), the required checks, and a severity.

changedFiles.description: Repo-relative POSIX paths of the files that changed.

tools.name: cortex.run_quality_gate
tools.description: Run the configured typecheck/lint/build/test commands plus route/env checks against the repo, returning a GateResult and the collected evidence.

tools.name: cortex.generate_ship_report
tools.description: Run the quality gate, persist evidence, and synthesize a ShipReport (READY / READY_WITH_WARNINGS / NOT_READY) with a suggested next-prompt when blocked.

tools.name: cortex.run_ui_gate
tools.description: Run the deep UI gate: deterministic JSX/Tailwind heuristics for responsive layout, data-state handling, accessibility, keyboard-navigation and dark-mode consistency. Returns a GateResult with per-category CheckResults plus the collected evidence.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.run_security_gate
tools.description: Run the deep security gate: heuristics for committed secrets, client-exposed secret env vars, secret leakage, unverified webhook signatures, missing input validation, permissive CORS, auth risks and dependency audit. Returns a GateResult with per-category CheckResults plus evidence.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.run_devops_gate
tools.description: Run the deep devops gate: heuristics for env-var wiring, Dockerfile hardening, secret exposure, Kubernetes non-root, CI health, build config and rollback plan. Returns a GateResult with per-category CheckResults plus evidence.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.run_product_gate
tools.description: Run the deep product-readiness gate: heuristics for placeholder pages, fake/non-wired buttons, dead links, missing loading/error states and unmet acceptance criteria on shipped/building features. Returns a GateResult with per-category CheckResults plus evidence.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.run_premium_ui_gate
tools.description: Score the UI surface across visual-hierarchy, mobile-responsiveness, spacing-consistency, accessibility and premium-feel dimensions (each 0-100), returning an overall score and the highest-leverage fixes ordered most-impactful-first. Deterministic; no threshold gating.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.verify_file
tools.description: Verify that a repo-relative file exists on disk, returning an EvidenceItem.

tools.name: cortex.verify_route
tools.description: Verify that a route is present in the project graph, returning an EvidenceItem.

tools.name: cortex.verify_symbol
tools.description: Verify that a top-level symbol is exported/defined in a file, returning an EvidenceItem.

tools.name: cortex.verify_import
tools.description: Verify that an import specifier resolves from a given source file, returning an EvidenceItem.

tools.name: cortex.verify_command
tools.description: Run a shell command in the repo root with a timeout and capture exit code + truncated output as an EvidenceItem (verified when it exits 0).

tools.name: cortex.verify_build
tools.description: Run the configured build command for the repo and capture the result as an EvidenceItem.

tools.name: cortex.block_unproven_done
tools.description: Given a ShipReport, decide whether work may be marked done. Returns { blocked, reasons }.

tools.name: cortex.recommend_skill
tools.description: Rank the skills relevant to a task by matching its wording against each skill's triggers, name and description. Considers both the built-in skill pack and project-local skills under .cortex/skills/.

limit.description: Maximum number of skills to return (default: all matches).

tools.name: cortex.install_skill
tools.description: Copy a built-in skill into the project skill store (.cortex/skills/<id>.json) so it becomes a project-local, editable skill. Rejects unknown or unsafely-named ids. Installation is explicit: the host agent decides when to call this after recommend_skill.

id.description: The id of a built-in skill to install (see recommend_skill).

tools.name: cortex.list_workflows
tools.description: List the built-in, risk-scaled workflow definitions. When taskType + risk are both supplied, also returns the workflow selected for that combination.

taskType.description: When set with risk, also return the selected workflow.

risk.description: When set with taskType, also return the selected workflow.

tools.name: cortex.run_workflow
tools.description: Execute a named workflow end-to-end (classify -> intent -> context -> blast-radius -> stack-pack -> verify -> regression -> memory -> ship-report -> learn), scaling depth by risk, and persist the WorkflowRun under .cortex/workflows/.

tools.name: cortex.explain_failure
tools.description: Scan the evidence ledger + flight recorder for repeated failure signatures, diagnose each root cause (missing-context / missing-skill / outdated-docs / wrong-package / bad-rule / missing-test / weak-agent / missing-mcp) and report the remedy kind the learning engine would create.

minOccurrences.description: Minimum recurrence for a signature to count as a learned failure (default: 2).

tools.name: cortex.create_regression_check
tools.description: Compute the blast radius of a set of changed files and persist its required checks as a durable regression-check constraint in the memory ledger, so the same verifications are re-run whenever those files change again.

changedFiles.description: Repo-relative POSIX paths of the files whose regression surface should be captured.

tools.name: cortex.generate_next_prompt
tools.description: Derive the next actionable prompt for the host agent from a ship report. Pass an existing ShipReport, or omit it to generate a fresh one by running the quality gate. Returns the report status and a concrete next instruction.

report.description: An existing ShipReport to derive the next prompt from. When omitted, a fresh report is generated.

tools.name: cortex.check_best_practices
tools.description: Return the best-practice and anti-pattern rules that apply to the project's detected stack, plus version checks and security/deployment notes. When a task is supplied, the rules whose text is relevant to that task are flagged.

task.description: When set, flag the rules most relevant to this task.

tools.name: cortex.recommend_mcp
tools.description: Rank the curated MCP catalog against a task description and the scanned project graph, best-first. Deterministic and tokenless: task keywords and hard stack signals (framework, env vars, scripts, file paths) drive the score; universally-useful servers (filesystem, git) always surface. Returns honestly-scoped McpServerSpecs (trust, permissions, tools, secretsRequired, sandbox).

task.description: Natural-language description of what you want the MCP server for.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default: all matches).

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.install_mcp_safely
tools.description: Install a vetted catalog server by id with a DEFAULT-READ-ONLY posture: empty env placeholders (never secret values), a namespaced devcortex annotation, the entry written to .mcp.json, and the McpServerSpec recorded under .cortex/mcp/. Refuses unknown (uncatalogued) ids. Confirm-before-overwrite: if the id already exists and force is not set, returns { status: "exists", plan } and writes NOTHING.

id.description: The id of a catalog server to install (see recommend_mcp).

force.description: Overwrite an existing .mcp.json entry for this id (default: false — confirm first).

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.evaluate_tool_call
tools.description: Ask the MCP security firewall for a verdict on a proposed tool call, evaluated against the persisted policy (.cortex/policies/mcp-firewall.json; safe read-only defaults when absent). Combines rule matching (deny > allow > require-approval), a 0-100 command-risk score (destructive/secret/network heuristics), and prompt-injection + secret scanning over the stringified args. An allow verdict escalates to require-approval on any injection signal or elevated risk. Returns { decision, reasons, riskScore, redactedArgs }.

tool.description: The tool name on that server, e.g. "delete_branch".

args.description: The arguments the agent wants to pass (any JSON-serialisable value); scanned + redacted, never persisted.

root.description: Override the target repo root for this call (defaults to the server root).

tools.name: cortex.redact_text
tools.description: Mask and tally secrets, credentials and PII (api-key, secret, token, private-key, password, env, db-url, email, phone) in a text buffer before it is logged, cached or sent to the cloud. Deterministic and tokenless (no LLM, no network). Returns { redacted, findings[] } where each finding reports a kind + the number of occurrences masked.

text.description: The text buffer to redact. Redaction is total over strings; empty input yields no findings.
